# VRFLogText

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Logging` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Logger/VRFLogText.cs#L16)

Builds the rich text a log row actually displays: search hits highlighted, and numbers,
quoted values and bracketed tags tinted so a long message can be read at a glance.
Everything is computed as spans over the plain message first and written out in a single
pass, so a highlight never lands inside a colour tag and produces broken markup.

## Methods

### ChannelColor(string) {#channelcolor-string}

Stable colour per channel, so the same subsystem always reads the same. The hue comes from
the low bits of the hash rather than the whole value: a full int scaled into a float has
nothing left of its fractional part, which lands every channel on the same red.
